acceptanceCriteria: Each named test passes -count=3 at host load >=40 or carries a bounded, documented deadline derived from observed cost rather than wall-clock guesses.
Full internal/tasks/store package completes within -timeout 30m at load >=40 on the 12-CPU host.
No assertion is weakened to hide a real ordering or freeing defect; any real defect found is split into its own BUG.
body: Observed 2026-10-16 by V1-1511 lane (PR beamfall/corvint#990) on BASE 653048415, Go 1.27.2, 12-CPU macOS host, load 44-116 with concurrent lane test shards. Failures: TestPSRAllBarrierTerminal (command boundary not reached), TestPSRSweepSuccessReplaySuccessor (not freed), TestCALV0089_DrainStopsContinuation (drained stage error context canceled after 22-26 s), TestCALV0089_CodexContinuationResumesPreservedSession (implement turns 3, want 2), TestPoolProcessDescendants/timeout. Same 10-test rerun: HEAD 5/10 fail, BASE 9/10 fail concurrently (load 78). Store test binary does not link internal/tasks/cli, so not caused by #990. Expected: pass or bounded load-insensitive deadlines; actual: timing failures and 30 m package timeout. Related: V1-1008 (TestPoolProcessDescendants), V1-0753 (PSR barrier, COMPLETED). Suspected load-sensitivity, not a confirmed product defect.
title: internal/tasks/store: pool, PSR and continuation tests fail under host load (BASE too); full package exceeds 30 m at load >=44
